conbody.p: This function repeats the adjustment of the lumbar support in a regular pattern to reduce back fatigue when driving continuously for a long time.

li.p: Select SetupVehicleSeatsErgo-motion seatLumbar Stabilization System while driving (Off, 30 min, 1hour) from the infotainment system.
If you press the lumbar support adjustment switch while the lumbar support function is operating while driving, the operation stops.
Activates automatically after 30 minutes or 1 hour of continuous driving.
